trickyParts: A collapsed comment turn renders MarkdownPreview (two lines, D7); the full MarkdownBody appears once the thread is expanded, and on the phone layout inside the 'Thread' dialog. The e2e opens the thread (by data-turn=comment:<id>) on both projects.

AskBlockCard cannot be imported by useRenderedMarkdown (AskBlockCard -> AskCard/AskOptionList -> AskOptionRow -> MarkdownBody -> useRenderedMarkdown cycle, biome noImportCycles), so the app provides it through the TextAskCard context; without a provider the ask keeps its source list.
The headless engine passes renderBlock the same BlockTypeSchema object Dispatch handed it; only the declared content type differs, so renderTypedBlock takes Pick<BlockTypeSchema, 'attributes'>.

Simplify made AskBlockView build its shell from renderAskBlockShell via DOMSerializer.renderSpec: same elements, attributes and order of children; attribute order on the frame differs (visible only in outerHTML text).

Round 2: once every typed block in a body has a [data-proof-block-content] hole, any rule written as '.proof-typed-block-ask [data-proof-block-content] ...' reaches the typed blocks of a reply or answer note inside the card's footer. The decision's own hole is a direct child of its section in both drawings (renderAskBlockShell; the schema's toDOM wrapper adds attributes only), so the four rules now use a child combinator.

Review round: the same reach applied to slot lookups. A nested decision's footer comes before the outer shell's own footer in document order, so slots are found with ':scope >' in both collectAskHosts and AskBlockView's slot(). askBlockShell now returns the frame's stamps and the fold decision once; collectAskHosts only collects, and the layout effect sets data-dispatch-ask-options from foldsOptions.
deviations: The plan said the comment turn renders the full MarkdownBody (ConversationTab.tsx:737); that line is a targeted message turn, and a comment's full body shows only with its thread expanded. The test expands the thread; acceptance and assertions are as planned.

The renderAskBlockShell spec-shape unit test a worker added was removed (it pinned source shape); its one consumer-visible invariant (no data-dispatch-ask-block in a body) is asserted in MarkdownBody.test.tsx instead.

The simplify pass applied four findings (one shell spec for editor and text engine, Fragment.replaceChild, the redundant type lookup, two copied shell fields); every check and the e2e set re-ran at the applied head b6720fc1.

Review round: the reviewer's nested-decision body used ':::ask' for both blocks, where the inner ':::' fence also closes the outer block; the test writes the outer block as '::::ask' (four colons, as the repository's other nested blocks do), which parses into one decision inside the other's option.
